items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that applies the given customizer.
Return a HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that can be used to build a HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory.
items.translation: 返回一个HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder，可用于构建一个HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsHttpClientBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying ConnectionConfig.Builder.
Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying PoolingHttpClientConnectionManagerBuilder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder，用于对底层PoolingHttpClientConnectionManagerBuilder应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying RequestConfig.Builder used for default requests.
Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying HttpClientBuilder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder，它会对底层HttpClientBuilder应用额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder that applies additional customization to the underlying SocketConfig.Builder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder，用于对底层的 SocketConfig.Builder 进行额外的自定义。

items.source: Return a new HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder with a replacement TlsSocketStrategy factory.
items.translation: 返回一个新的HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactoryBuilder，带有一个替换的TlsSocketStrategy 工厂。
客户端 HTTP 支持类。
